U-2-Net (U2NETP), Xuebin Qin and contributors, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
ONNX model distributed by rembg: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0
ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1, Microsoft Corporation, MIT.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

Modified human model: convolution weights rounded to FP16 precision and stored as FP32; gzip compression. Original graph / architecture preserved.

Anime Segmentation ISNet, SkyTNT, Apache-2.0. Unmodified ONNX weights, downloaded on demand from model author:
https://huggingface.co/skytnt/anime-seg/tree/493cb60893f47441b26ec4fb9a306bce9e342982
https://github.com/SkyTNT/anime-segmentation

BiRefNet, Copyright (c) 2024 ZhengPeng, MIT.
https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet
Browser ONNX export: studioludens/birefnet-lite-512 (MIT), FP32, input 512 x 512.
Pinned revision 4a3c40c36c94093cc1e724d9ea428b8fa4b57dc7, downloaded on demand; images stay local.
https://huggingface.co/studioludens/birefnet-lite-512
The 512 export limits fine detail on large images. It is offered for photos/objects; complex anime scenes may fail.
See LICENSE-BiRefNet.txt.
